release.scope_note: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION EXCHANGE v0.3.1. Every record is a synthetic structural scenario for contract testing; no original policy file or excerpt is imported, nothing is approved public data, and all public download/excerpt/score gates are CLOSED (public_release_approved: false). Regression scenarios model the structure of Colombia Resolution 0777 (2022), an Indonesian BRIN Regulation 12/2023, a UCT repository-policy 2014/2016/2020 genealogy, and an attested-but-unrecovered UPTC Agreement 2/2026 news lead — without importing real text.
